documents.text:
# Supplier invoice approval policy

Invoices above 50000 require approval by a second finance approver before payment.

# Unrelated synthetic note

Warehouse access badges expire after thirty days.

# Fulfillment retry runbook

The fulfillment retry worker makes at most five delivery attempts, then places the job in review.

# Unrelated synthetic note

The support team rotates API credentials every quarter.

# Identity migration note

Keep the Unicode account key ＡＣＭＥ-42 stable during identity migration.

# Unrelated synthetic note

The service window begins at 09:00 UTC on Monday.

# Ledger maintenance schedule

Ledger maintenance is approved for Sunday 02:00–03:00 UTC.

# Unrelated synthetic note

Refund requests are reviewed within two business days.

# Supplier matching design

Supplier name matching uses Unicode NFKC followed by full case folding.

# Unrelated synthetic note

The archive format is newline-delimited JSON.

# Synthetic audit retention policy

Synthetic audit events are retained for 400 days, then removed from the active store.

# Unrelated synthetic note

The report export is available in CSV and JSON.

# Key management overview

Key rotation is triggered by a verified compromise or the configured 90-day interval.

# Unrelated synthetic note

Keys are stored in the managed secrets service.

# Language support decision

Production language support requires a reviewed tokenizer and an evaluated embedding model.

# Unrelated synthetic note

The document ingestion job accepts plain text and PDF.

# North tenant purchasing guide

The north tenant requires second approval for invoices above 50000 credits.

# Unrelated synthetic note

The south tenant uses a 25000-credit threshold for its synthetic purchasing example.
Synthetic access-control sentinel for north tenant.
Synthetic access-control sentinel for south tenant.
